newsitem.title: USA: GenRad named a supplier by auto company.
newsitem.headline: GenRad named a supplier by auto company.

text.p: GenRad Inc said on Wednesday that its Advanced Diagnostic Solutions division was named a supplier by a U.S. automotive original equipment manufacturer for the auto company's future worldwide diagnostic system project.
GenRad in its news release did not name the auto company, but said the agreement would be a multmillion-dollar, multiyear contract. Its terms have not been finalized, GenRad added.

Advanced Diagnostic Solutions, based in Manchester, England would supply software development tools, diagnostic applications authoring and hardware systems throughout the world to the auto company's dealerships, GenRad said.
GedRad provides manufacturers with hardware, software and services designed to improve productivity.
